noteGrp.note: Book of Life commemorates biblical figures, saints, Doctors of the Church, councils, the departed, pastors or prelates, and benefactors. It was compiled for the Syrian Jacobite Church of the Mother of God at Aleppo, belonging to a wider tradition also attested at Beth Svirino. and was recited after the Kiss of Peace. The Aleppo recension preserves chiefly the universal and liturgical framework of this commemorative tradition.

note.quote: ܥܠ ܚܝܠܐ ܕܬܠܝܬܝܘ ܩܕܝܫܬܐ ܣܓܝܕܬܐ: ܘܫܘܝܬ ܒܐܘܣܝܐ:ܐܒܐ ܘܒܪܐ ܘܪܘܚܐ ܩܕܝܫܐ ܚܕ ܐܠܗܐ ܫܪܝܪܐ ܡܫܪܝܢܢ ܠܡܟܬܒ ܟܬܒܐ ܕܣܦܪ ܫܡܗܐ ܕܐܒܗܬܐ ܩܕܡܝܐ ܟܐܢܐ ܘܟܗܢܐ ܢܒܝܐ ܘܫܠܝܚܐ ܘܣܗܕܐ ܘܡܘܕܝܢܐ ܘܐܒܗܬܐ ܩܕܝܫܐ ܘܪܥܘܬܐ ܫܪܝܪܐ ܘܡܠܦܢܐ ܬܪܝܨܝܝ ܫܘ ܘܟܗܢܐ ܘܪܝܫܝ ܥܕܬܐ ܘܪܝܫܝ ܕܝܪܬܐ ܘܝܚܝܕܝܐ ܘܥܢܘܝܐ ܘܩܫܝܫܐ ܘܡܫܡܫܢܐ ܘܕܝܪܝܐ ܘܕܝܪܝܬܐ ܘܫܪܟܐ ܕܡܗܝܡܢܐ ܫܪܝܪܐ ܒܢܝ ܥܠܡܐ ܓܢܒܐ ܘܢܫܐ ܪܒܐ ܘܙܥܘܪܐ ܘܟܠ ܩܘܡܢ ܘܡܘܫܚܢ ܕܒܢܝܐ ܕܥܕܬܐ ܩܕܝܫܐ ܩܐܬܘܠܝܩܐ ܫܠܝܚܝܬܐ ܕܡܬܐܡܪ ܣܦܪ ܚܝܐ.

By the power of the holy and adorable Trinity, equal in essence, Father and Son and Holy Spirit, one true God, we begin to write the copy of the book of the names of the former just fathers and priests, prophets and apostles and martyrs and confessors, and holy fathers and true pastors and teachers of orthodoxy, and priests and heads of churches and heads of monasteries, and solitaries and ascetics, and presbyters and deacons, and monks and nuns, and the rest of the true believers, lay folk, men and women, great and small, and all estates and conditions of the sons of the holy catholic apostolic Church, which is called the Book of Life.
ܐܬܕܟܪ ܡܪܝܐ ܒܪܚܡܝܟ ܠܐܝܠܝܢ ܕܝܨܦܘ ܘܠܐܝܘ ܢܚܣܐ ܠܗܘܢ ܡܝܪܐ.
Remember, Lord, in Thy mercies those who have been careful and have toiled. May the Lord pardon them.
